## NS.scanByIP() method

Get the list of IPs connected to a server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
scanByIP(host?: string): string[];
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  host | string | _(Optional)_ Optional. Hostname/IP of the server to scan, default to current server. |

**Returns:**

string\[\]

Returns an array of IP addresses

## Remarks

RAM cost: 0.2 GB

Returns an array containing the IP addresses of all servers that are one node way from the specified target server. The IP addresses in the returned array are strings.

Works identically to [ns.scan](./bitburner.ns.scan.md)<!-- -->.
